title: Run a command on a remote server via SSH
summary: Execute a single command on a remote computer without opening an interactive shell session. The -t flag allocates a terminal, allowing interaction if needed.

steps.explain: Use ssh with the -t flag to run a specific command on the remote host. This is useful for quick tasks or scripts.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username on the remote server

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server
